description: The plot illustrates how accuracy at rank 1 (Accuracy@1) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models, shown as two line series. The x-axis is labeled “Num of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale, with visible tick marks at 3 and 5 and the plotted values spanning from 1 to 7 child nodes. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale, with labeled ticks at 20, 25, 30, and 35 and values shown in percent. One series for GPT-4o is drawn as a darker blue solid line with circular markers; its annotated values are 24.4 at 1 child node, 28.9 at 3, 34.4 at 5, and 31.1 at 7, rising from 1 to 5 and then decreasing from 5 to 7. The other series (Claude-3.5, as indicated by the legend) is drawn as a lighter blue solid line with “x” markers; its annotated values are 26.7 at 1 child node, 27.8 at 3, 24.4 at 5, and 20.0 at 7, showing a small increase from 1 to 3 followed by decreases from 3 to 5 and from 5 to 7.
